targets._doc: Both are counted per person contacted, not per email sent.

pause_at._doc: The daily read says PAUSE for a campaign at or over this. Not the owner's number: see STATUS.md.

charter.who: companies that could use Justin as a fractional staff member; the audience is his to name at intake, and companies Lead Radar found hiring a virtual assistant or an AI role are the first list
charter.how: a plain email from a real person: plain text, no images, no tracking, no link, reply only

charter._doc: From Justin's words of 2026-11-20, in repo/fractional/MESSAGES.md.

first_lines._doc: model: the exact id the Codex CLI lists for the model the owner named; blank uses the CLI's own default. fallback: the line a row gets when the engine gives none; it uses columns the list has. On this bot there is no fallback line: a row with no true line waits.

fractional.audience: given at intake; job-post companies from Lead Radar first
